title: 1688 Product & Supplier Finder — development preview
description: Development preview: enter product keywords or numeric Offer IDs. IDs take priority. Image search and search-results links are not supported. The owner selects the data backend; customers do not provide provider keys. The default browser backend uses chargeable Apify residential proxies. The optional Elim API backend is disabled pending owner activation and commercial permission. Live collection is not release-validated.

keywords.title: Search keywords (English or Chinese)
keywords.description: Enter one product name per line. Replace the example with your products. Each keyword is searched separately. These keywords are ignored when Offer IDs are provided. Titles are collected as displayed; automatic translation is not included.

offerIds.title: Offer IDs
offerIds.description: Already know the products? Enter their numeric 1688 product IDs, one per line. For detail.1688.com/offer/1071313125369.html, enter 1071313125369. IDs take priority: keyword search is skipped. Do not paste full URLs. Returned detail fields depend on the owner-selected backend; completeness is not guaranteed.

maxResults.title: Maximum products per keyword
maxResults.description: Maximum unique products from each keyword, not the whole run. 10,000 is a hard ceiling, not an unlimited setting or a guarantee. Collection also stops at the page limit or last page. Ignored for Offer IDs.

maxPagesPerKeyword.title: Maximum pages per keyword
maxPagesPerKeyword.description: Read result pages until this limit, the product target or the last available page is reached. Offer IDs do not use this setting. The optional API backend also has a separate owner-controlled whole-run request cap.

orderQuantity.title: How many items do you plan to order?
orderQuantity.description: Compare your planned quantity with the displayed minimum order quantity (MOQ). Does not turn listing or variant prices into a confirmed order quotation.

useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify residential proxies
useApifyProxy.description: Browser backend only: use the RESIDENTIAL proxy group and country below. Traffic costs are billed through Apify. Requires available proxy coverage; does not guarantee access or dismiss verification. Ignored by the optional Elim API backend.

proxyCountryMode.title: Residential proxy country
proxyCountryMode.description: Browser backend only: select one country for the run. Availability depends on the account and proxy pool. No automatic country or identity changes after denial. Ignored when proxies are disabled or the owner selects the Elim API backend.

failOnNoResults.title: Stop on the first collection error
failOnNoResults.description: When off, continue after ordinary browser layout/not-found errors and retain earlier products. Runs with no products always fail. Login, verification, access denial and provider API failures always stop the run.

saveCsvFile.title: Save CSV download files
saveCsvFile.description: Save a product CSV and 1688_suppliers.csv under Storage → Key-value store. The dataset and run-summary files are separate.

csvFilename.title: Product CSV filename
csvFilename.description: Use a simple .csv filename. 1688_suppliers.csv is reserved for the separate supplier shortlist.
